      <description><![CDATA[Founded in 2008, eMudhra has grown from a certifying authority into a digital trust company serving government agencies, banks and some of India’s largest technology firms. Its key breakthrough came in 2015, when it was empanelled as an e-sign service provider for Aadhaar-based services, opening doors to a range of digital documentation needs. Listed in 2022, the company now counts SBI, LIC, TCS, Infosys and Tech Mahindra among its clients. But how did eMudhra build such deep integrations across sectors, and what challenges does its business model face today? Watch accompanying video for full report.]]></description>
